_comment: Fishing spots: real jetties, groynes and foreshores. near: [x, z] world metres, either a pier deck the map built from OSM (kind deck) or the real place (kind shore). stand: [x, y, z] where you fish from and yaw the way you face the water, both found in the map by tools/field/place_spots.gd. water picks the fish (data/field/fish.json); tags: jetty (pylons), crabs (crab net), flats (sand), snags, deep, rocks, beach, lights (under lights at night), hubcap. hidden: a quiet spot (map POI `poi`) left off the journal until you find it.

spots.name: Mends Street jetty
spots.hint: The South Perth ferry jetty. Bream round the pylons after dark.

spots.name: Coode Street jetty
spots.hint: The little jetty off Coode Street in South Perth. Crab nets in summer, whiting over the flats.

spots.name: Point Fraser
spots.hint: The boardwalk at Point Fraser, under the Causeway. Shallow, sandy, good for whiting and crabs.

spots.name: Heirisson Island
spots.hint: The sandy edges of Heirisson Island, where the kangaroos are. Whiting and flathead on the flats.

spots.name: Claisebrook Cove
spots.hint: The cove off East Perth, all snags and old timbers. Bream at night.

spots.name: East Perth jetty
spots.hint: The old jetty past the Causeway in East Perth. Quiet, and the bream know the pylons.

spots.name: Burswood jetty
spots.hint: The jetty off the Burswood foreshore, by the snags along the bank. Bream after dark.

spots.name: Maylands foreshore
spots.hint: The Maylands bank by the old airfield, among the snags. A bream spot at dusk.

spots.name: Garratt Road bridge
spots.hint: Under the Garratt Road bridge, up past Bayswater. Deep water: the locals fish it at night for mulloway.

spots.name: Elizabeth Quay
spots.hint: The Barrack Street Jetty at Elizabeth Quay, in the city. Mostly blowies. People say things turn up off the old Esplanade.

spots.name: Canning Bridge
spots.hint: Canning Bridge, where the two rivers meet. Deep holes, crabs, and the odd mulloway after dark.

spots.name: Claremont jetty
spots.hint: The Claremont jetty on Freshwater Bay. Tailor in the evenings, herring and skippy by day.

spots.name: Freshwater Bay jetty
spots.hint: The jetty in Freshwater Bay, Peppermint Grove. A crab net spot, and whiting off the sand.

spots.name: Mosman Bay jetty
spots.hint: Mosman Bay, under the cliffs. Deep water close in: snapper and mulloway at night.

spots.name: Point Walter jetty
spots.hint: The jetty at Point Walter, by the sandbar. Whiting on the flats on a warm day, tailor at dusk.

spots.name: Point Walter sandbar
spots.hint: Out along the sandbar at Point Walter, knee deep at low tide. Whiting and flathead on the sand, and nobody else.

spots.name: East Fremantle jetties
spots.hint: The jetties off East Fremantle, by the rowing clubs. Crabs in summer, tailor at dusk.

spots.name: Fishing Boat Harbour
spots.hint: Fremantle's Fishing Boat Harbour. Squid under the lights at night.

spots.name: Fremantle harbour
spots.hint: The harbour walls in Fremantle. Squid under the lights, tarwhine and skippy, snapper after dark.

spots.name: North Mole
spots.hint: The long North Mole at the river mouth, out past the port. Herring and skippy by day, tailor at the change of light.

spots.name: Leighton Beach
spots.hint: The beach north of the port. Herring, whiting and tailor off the sand.

spots.name: Cottesloe groyne
spots.hint: The groyne at Cottesloe. Skippy and herring off the rocks, KGs over the sand.

spots.name: City Beach groyne
spots.hint: The groynes at City Beach. Tailor at dawn and dusk, whiting off the sand.

spots.name: Trigg Point
spots.hint: The point at Trigg, all reef and wash. Herring, skippy and the odd KG whiting.

spots.name: Trigg Island rocks
spots.hint: The limestone rocks off Trigg, where the swell breaks. Skippy and herring in the wash, tailor at dusk.
